problem: Website visitors get stuck on forms and policy questions, and businesses cannot staff a live agent for every visitor, language and hour.
solution: An installable voice and text copilot that answers from the business's own documents and walks visitors through forms, run for the business as a service.
mechanism: one script tag installs the widget
each turn becomes one small decision that code carries out
every value is read back and confirmed; the visitor submits

evidence.claim: The owner defined the product as a repeatedly installable copilot agent for any website, run as a service, that people can talk to like a live agent in any language, with phone calls later.
evidence.supports: Sets the product scope recorded in PROJECT.md.
evidence.limits: Does not show that multi-language, phone calls or hosting have been built.
